dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Presence of a high-density, low-intensity (dark) circular core near the center-right region, which lacks an internal gradient. Other low-intensity clusters are dispersed between ring structures, creating a fragmented, high-contrast mosaic.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the most prominent central 'O' ring, the upper-center 'O' ring, and a mid-left 'C' structure form an obtuse scalene triangle.
